capabilities: Sync the vault across devices through a user-owned Git-host repository
Merge concurrent edits line by line, keeping both versions on conflict
Restore files, folders or the whole vault to earlier points and recover deletions
Encrypt vault contents and file names end-to-end before they reach the host
Review pending changes with editor line markers, diffs and a status panel
extras: Free with no telemetry; README notes the plugin has not been manually reviewed by Obsidian staff, and per-host maturity differs (GitHub stable, GitLab/Gitea/Forgejo/Bitbucket beta).
problem: Vault syncing and backup typically requires either a paid service or installing and managing Git yourself, and neither merges conflicting edits from multiple devices line by line.

requires.name: Git host account (GitHub, GitLab, Bitbucket, Gitea/Forgejo/Codeberg)

summary: Vault sync plugin that backs up and merges the vault across desktop and mobile through GitHub, GitLab, Gitea, Forgejo or Bitbucket, without installing Git.
